docs.purpose: Lets an admin view, add, and edit the rules that automatically classify permit descriptions into trade categories such as plumbing or electrical — the engine that decides which trade leads a permit generates.
docs.data_story: It reads 2 tables — `trade_mapping_rules` and `trades` and writes `trade_mapping_rules`. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 10 fields, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. **Nothing in this repository calls it.** That is the state this registry exists to make visible, not a claim that it is dead — a caller could be a bookmark, an external system, or a path built from variables. It mutates admin state and writes **no `admin_audit_log` row** — one of the nine measured gaps Phase 0 closes.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `MUTATION`. It declares `database.writes[]` with a `write_discipline` per target (the Spec 122 vocabulary verbatim), its idempotency posture, its optimistic contract and its rollback. Its `consumers[]` is the field that matters most here: today it is empty, and the orphan panel renders that as a red row rather than leaving it to be discovered years later.

notes: POST (create rule) and PATCH (update rule) have NO writeAdminAudit call — trade-rule creation and edits are unaudited even though they directly steer lead classification. No SPEC LINK and no verifyAdminAuth import. PATCH builds its SET clause dynamically but only from a hardcoded MUTABLE_FIELDS allow-list with parameterized values, so it is not an injection surface. POST/PATCH respond with RETURNING * (whole row); only GET has the explicit column list recorded above. No in-repo caller found. | MEASURED 2026-09-15: FINDINGS. (1) MISSING GUARD: no verifyAdminAuth call. src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:9-11 states every route under src/app/api/admin/**/route.ts MUST call it as the first line; this route does not, so the only gate is the presence-only middleware check (src/middleware.ts:115) that src/middleware.ts:107-114 explicitly says is not a real verifier. Consequence: the mutating POST/PATCH also get no CSRF Origin check (src/lib/auth/verify-admin.ts:70-78 never runs) and no aal2/MFA gate. (2) ENVELOPE DEVIATION: all 12 handler-authored responses are bare (see envelope.deviations). (3) `RETURNING *` at :70 and :132 spreads every trade_mapping_rules column into the response unfiltered — a new column is auto-exposed. (4) PATCH builds its SET clause by string concatenation (:114) — NOT injectable, because field names come only from the MUTABLE_FIELDS literal (:103-106) and values are parameterised (:115), but the pattern is worth a lock. (5) Validation asymmetry: POST enforces the ALLOWED_FIELDS and confidence-range rules (:50-63) that PATCH does not (:112-117), so a rule that POST would reject can be PATCHed into existence. (6) CENSUS AGREES: census_reads [trade_mapping_rules, trades] and census_writes [trade_mapping_rules] are all confirmed in code; nothing missing, nothing extra. (7) No SELECT * on this route. (8) census `consumers: []` — I did not attempt to verify consumers (out of scope of the files I read). | Caching: none observed — no Cache-Control header, no `export const revalidate`, no `export const dynamic`, no in-process cache in the file (grep for Cache-Control|revalidate|dynamic|runtime over the file returns no match). | ORPHAN — zero call sites in src/** or mobile/** (sweep 2026-09-15, comment lines stripped). | No test file under src/tests/** imports this route.
